agent_configs_schedule_cron_mode_check.name: agent_configs_schedule_cron_mode_check
agent_configs_schedule_cron_mode_check.value: ("agent_configs"."schedule_mode" = 'manual' AND "agent_configs"."schedule_cron" IS NULL) OR ("agent_configs"."schedule_mode" = 'cron' AND "agent_configs"."schedule_cron" IS NOT NULL)

agent_deployments_error_detail_code_chec.name: agent_deployments_error_detail_code_check
agent_deployments_error_detail_code_chec.value: "agent_deployments"."error_detail" IS NULL OR "agent_deployments"."error_code" IS NOT NULL

agent_deployments_lease_pair_check.name: agent_deployments_lease_pair_check
agent_deployments_lease_pair_check.value: ("agent_deployments"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "agent_deployments"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("agent_deployments"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_deployments"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

agent_deployments_runner_operation_pair_.name: agent_deployments_runner_operation_pair_check
agent_deployments_runner_operation_pair_.value: ("agent_deployments"."runner_operation_id" IS NULL AND "agent_deployments"."runner_accepted_at" IS NULL) OR ("agent_deployments"."runner_operation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_deployments"."runner_accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

agent_deployments_stage_runner_operation.name: agent_deployments_stage_runner_operation_check
agent_deployments_stage_runner_operation.value: "agent_deployments"."stage" NOT IN ('starting_gateway', 'verifying_model', 'connecting_telegram', 'ready') OR ("agent_deployments"."runner_operation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_deployments"."runner_accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

agent_deployments_canary_started_check.name: agent_deployments_canary_started_check
agent_deployments_canary_started_check.value: "agent_deployments"."canary_state" <> 'started' OR ("agent_deployments"."canary_attempted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_deployments"."canary_completed_at" IS NULL)

agent_deployments_canary_terminal_check.name: agent_deployments_canary_terminal_check
agent_deployments_canary_terminal_check.value: "agent_deployments"."canary_state" NOT IN ('passed', 'failed') OR ("agent_deployments"."canary_attempted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_deployments"."canary_completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_deployments"."canary_completed_at" >= "agent_deployments"."canary_attempted_at")

agent_deployments_canary_unknown_check.name: agent_deployments_canary_unknown_check
agent_deployments_canary_unknown_check.value: "agent_deployments"."canary_state" <> 'outcome_unknown' OR ("agent_deployments"."canary_attempted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_deployments"."canary_completed_at" IS NULL)

agent_deployments_completed_stage_check.name: agent_deployments_completed_stage_check
agent_deployments_completed_stage_check.value: ("agent_deployments"."stage" = 'ready' AND "agent_deployments"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("agent_deployments"."stage" <> 'ready' AND "agent_deployments"."completed_at" IS NULL)

agent_deployments_failed_stage_check.name: agent_deployments_failed_stage_check
agent_deployments_failed_stage_check.value: ("agent_deployments"."stage" = 'failed' AND "agent_deployments"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("agent_deployments"."stage" <> 'failed' AND "agent_deployments"."failed_at" IS NULL)

agent_deployments_ready_error_check.name: agent_deployments_ready_error_check
agent_deployments_ready_error_check.value: "agent_deployments"."stage" <> 'ready' OR ("agent_deployments"."error_code" IS NULL AND "agent_deployments"."error_detail" IS NULL)

agent_deployments_terminal_clear_work_ch.name: agent_deployments_terminal_clear_work_check
agent_deployments_terminal_clear_work_ch.value: "agent_deployments"."stage" NOT IN ('ready', 'failed') OR ("agent_deployments"."next_attempt_at" IS NULL AND "agent_deployments"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "agent_deployments"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

agent_deployments_completed_after_starte.name: agent_deployments_completed_after_started_check
agent_deployments_completed_after_starte.value: "agent_deployments"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "agent_deployments"."started_at" IS NULL OR "agent_deployments"."completed_at" >= "agent_deployments"."started_at"

agent_deployments_failed_after_started_c.name: agent_deployments_failed_after_started_check
agent_deployments_failed_after_started_c.value: "agent_deployments"."failed_at" IS NULL OR "agent_deployments"."started_at" IS NULL OR "agent_deployments"."failed_at" >= "agent_deployments"."started_at"

agent_secrets_telegram_metadata_kind_che.name: agent_secrets_telegram_metadata_kind_check
agent_secrets_telegram_metadata_kind_che.value: "agent_secrets"."kind" = 'telegram_bot_token' OR ("agent_secrets"."uniqueness_fingerprint" IS NULL AND "agent_secrets"."provider_subject_id" IS NULL AND "agent_secrets"."provider_username" IS NULL)

agent_secrets_telegram_metadata_pair_che.name: agent_secrets_telegram_metadata_pair_check
agent_secrets_telegram_metadata_pair_che.value: "agent_secrets"."kind" <> 'telegram_bot_token' OR ("agent_secrets"."uniqueness_fingerprint" IS NULL AND "agent_secrets"."provider_subject_id" IS NULL AND "agent_secrets"."provider_username" IS NULL) OR ("agent_secrets"."uniqueness_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_secrets"."provider_subject_id" IS NOT NULL)

agent_secrets_revoked_status_check.name: agent_secrets_revoked_status_check
agent_secrets_revoked_status_check.value: ("agent_secrets"."status" = 'revoked' AND "agent_secrets"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("agent_secrets"."status" <> 'revoked' AND "agent_secrets"."revoked_at" IS NULL)

backups_restored_at_status_check.name: backups_restored_at_status_check
backups_restored_at_status_check.value: ("backups"."status" = 'restored' AND "backups"."restored_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("backups"."status" <> 'restored' AND "backups"."restored_at" IS NULL)

docker_runner_containers_started_finishe.name: docker_runner_containers_started_finished_order_check
docker_runner_containers_started_finishe.value: "docker_runner_containers"."finished_at" IS NULL OR "docker_runner_containers"."started_at" IS NULL OR "docker_runner_containers"."finished_at" >= "docker_runner_containers"."started_at"

runner_credentials_revoked_status_check.name: runner_credentials_revoked_status_check
runner_credentials_revoked_status_check.value: ("runner_credentials"."status" = 'revoked' AND "runner_credentials"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("runner_credentials"."status" <> 'revoked' AND "runner_credentials"."revoked_at" IS NULL)

runner_registration_tokens_used_status_c.name: runner_registration_tokens_used_status_check
runner_registration_tokens_used_status_c.value: ("runner_registration_tokens"."status" = 'used' AND "runner_registration_tokens"."used_at" IS NOT NULL AND "runner_registration_tokens"."runner_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("runner_registration_tokens"."status" <> 'used' AND "runner_registration_tokens"."used_at" IS NULL)

runner_registration_tokens_revoked_statu.name: runner_registration_tokens_revoked_status_check
runner_registration_tokens_revoked_statu.value: ("runner_registration_tokens"."status" = 'revoked' AND "runner_registration_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("runner_registration_tokens"."status" <> 'revoked' AND "runner_registration_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NULL)

runners_active_user_endpoint_idx.name: runners_active_user_endpoint_idx
runners_active_user_endpoint_idx.where: "runners"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "runners"."endpoint_url" IS NOT NULL

runners_digitalocean_provider_fields_che.name: runners_digitalocean_provider_fields_check
runners_digitalocean_provider_fields_che.value: ("runners"."kind" = 'manual_vps' AND "runners"."provider" IS NULL AND "runners"."provider_resource_id" IS NULL AND "runners"."region" IS NULL AND "runners"."size_slug" IS NULL AND "runners"."image" IS NULL AND "runners"."provisioning_status" IS NULL AND "runners"."provisioning_error" IS NULL AND "runners"."provisioning_started_at" IS NULL AND "runners"."provisioning_completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("runners"."kind" = 'digitalocean' AND "runners"."provider" = 'digitalocean' AND "runners"."region" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."size_slug" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."image" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."provisioning_status" IS NOT NULL)

runners_provisioning_completed_after_sta.name: runners_provisioning_completed_after_started_check
runners_provisioning_completed_after_sta.value: "runners"."provisioning_completed_at" IS NULL OR "runners"."provisioning_started_at" IS NULL OR "runners"."provisioning_completed_at" >= "runners"."provisioning_started_at"
